question: In R^2, graph (3/2)(x - 2y) < -x + 5. Label the boundary with an equivalent integer-coefficient equation and label its intercepts. Shade the correct side and mark A = (0,0), B = (2,0), C = (-1,-3), D = (2,1), identifying membership and strict boundary exclusion.

qualitativeClaims.expected: Draw a dashed line labelled 5x - 6y = 10 through (2,0) and (0,-5/3). Shade 5x - 6y < 10, equivalently y > (5/6)x - 5/3.
A=(0,0) is shaded (0<10); B=(2,0) is on the dashed boundary and excluded (10=10); C=(-1,-3) is unshaded (13>10); D=(2,1) is shaded (4<10).
